zh-CN.title: 科研任务与汇报协作
items: 课题采用紧凑单行导航，任务表单分区更清晰，日报、周报、月报改为单选
日期统一使用连续月历，支持 1900–2099 年与年月跳转；下拉选择统一采用友间组件
汇报新增工时滚轮和日期筛选，报告与评论区分展示，答复状态更清晰

en.title: Research tasks and reporting
items: Compact project navigation and clearer task forms, with one reporting frequency per task
A shared scrolling calendar covers 1900–2099 with month jumps; selections consistently use Frienden pickers
Reports gain duration wheels, date filtering and distinct styling, with clearer response states
